supersedes.reason: The frozen event-risk contract requires a point-in-time historical event snapshot. No such causal archive exists in the repository, and current API responses cannot reconstruct what was known historically. V1 is superseded before execution and before any development PnL was viewed.

candidate.entry_execution: next aligned 15m open after the frozen confirmation chain

scheduled_event_layer.reason: No causal point-in-time historical event snapshot is available.
scheduled_event_layer.future_role: prospective risk overlay only; it cannot rescue a failed development result

development_data.fold_method: 10 contiguous chronological day-aligned folds; first six contain 55 days and last four contain 54 days
development_data.fold_assignment: trade belongs to the fold containing its entry timestamp

execution_partition.portfolio_aggregation: all accepted candidates merged globally by entry time, symbol and side

portfolio.risk_sizing: notional = current realized equity * risk fraction / structural stop distance fraction

cost_model.funding: timestamped Binance USD-M historical funding rates are mandatory
cost_model.funding_source: official Binance Vision monthly fundingRate archives
cost_model.missing_funding_rule: official verdict becomes INCOMPLETE_FUNDING_DATA and cannot pass

trade_accounting.intrabar_ambiguity: stop-first when stop and target are both touched inside the same 5m candle
trade_accounting.unresolved_at_study_end: close at the final available 5m close before end_exclusive
trade_accounting.same_symbol_overlap: later entries rejected while an accepted position on the symbol remains open

drawdown.primary_method: conservative realized equity minus all active structural risk at each entry and exit event

decision_rule.pass: All development gates pass for the single frozen candidate and funding coverage is complete.
decision_rule.fail: Any performance gate fails; do not tune this candidate from observed PnL.
decision_rule.insufficient_activity: Fewer than 60 accepted trades is a development failure.
decision_rule.selection: Exactly one candidate exists; no best-of-many selection is permitted.

after_pass_only.holdout_period: must be selected from data never used for recognition, semantic review or development

prohibited_after_result: adding the event layer to rescue a failure
VPS, paper or live before required gates
execution_gate: Run only after CI for the implementation and this preregistration is green.
